app_store_listing.subtitle: Smart Task Management with Pomodoro & Mood Tracking
app_store_listing.description:
Tazbeet is a comprehensive task management app designed to boost your productivity.

Features include:

- Task creation and management with categories
- Pomodoro timer for focused work sessions
- Mood tracking to monitor your well-being
- Smart notifications and reminders
- Calendar integration
- Progress tracking and analytics
- Recurring tasks support
- Data synchronization across devices

Perfect for students, professionals, and anyone looking to organize their life and achieve their goals.

app_review_info.notes: Tazbeet is a productivity app that includes task management, a Pomodoro timer, and mood tracking. It uses Firebase for authentication and data storage and supports Apple Sign-In.
